title: Research for a planned sprint lands under its item
goal: A research task or story of a planned (not started) sprint can land its kb content commits with KB-Work and be proven by backlog.py done without starting the sprint, as backlog.md states; check-trailers accepts such a commit only when it changes kb content and the item files, never _tools/, .claude/ or CI; ST-rjxacpdh, TK-nytjligk and the ST-mmmn42ks tasks, whose research landed without KB-Work, are closed or dropped with the commit named

gates.question: The goal needs backlog.py done to prove a research item of a planned sprint, but _tools/backlog.py is not in touches. Today claim and done refuse a draft item (done TK-nytjligk --dry-run: status draft), and check rejects status todo, doing or done while the item's sprint is planned (backlog.py check, WORKED). Widen touches to _tools/backlog.py?
options: widen touches to _tools/backlog.py: claim, done and check accept a research item of a planned sprint
narrow the goal: done proves such an item only once its sprint starts; check-trailers and the docs change alone
gates.recommendation: Widen touches to _tools/backlog.py, and run it after the in-flight TK-cjoc2gm4 (which changes backlog.py) lands. TK-nytjligk's three checks give coverage: good on main now (b6baa207), so it can then be closed naming that commit.

notes: Research landed ahead of planned sprints without KB-Work, because check-trailers refuses work for items outside a started sprint: 7d1175f7 (meets ST-rjxacpdh's goal), b6baa207 (TK-nytjligk), d0db1b38 (the ST-mmmn42ks tasks). Changing check-trailers is a rule change: the runbook and git.md change with it. ST-rjxacpdh is closed: it landed under KB-Work in SP-fkyrld5h (git log --grep "KB-Work: ST-rjxacpdh").
